fourth_down.source: Stone's standing fourth-down rule (user, October 18, 2026, with his answers "FG to 52 yards", "Go past midfield" and "Tice's first call"): fourth-and-2 or less, go, with Tice's first call on the matching menu; fourth-and-3 or 4, go on the opponent's side of midfield, otherwise the field goal or the punt by the field-goal line; fourth-and-5 or more, a field goal when the kick is 52 yards or less, otherwise a punt. A kick is the line of scrimmage plus the bound fourth-down artifact's field-goal snap offset (library/data/2010_2014w4_fourth_down_decisions.json field_goal_offset, modal 18), so a 52-yard kick is the opponent's 34 and the field-goal line is the 34; past midfield is the opponent's 49 and in.

kickoff.source: Stone's standing kickoff rule (user, October 16, 2026): "League practice (recommended). Onside when trailing by 1 to 16 with 2:00 or less left. Onside when trailing by 9 to 16 with 5:00 or less left. Deep otherwise."

two_point.source: Stone's standing two-point rule (user, October 17, 2026, answer "Option 2 (Recommended)"): kick, except go for two in the fourth quarter when the touchdown leaves Jacksonville down 2, up 1 or down 5.

lead_late.note: The packets' 'lead late' names no clock. The record applies the second half's last 2:00 with the defense leading (the offense's two-minute window); the second half's last 4:00 is the other candidate. A labelling convention, never Stone's definition.

third-and-long.text: Dime, Nickel Even, Quarters or Cover 6

two-minute.text: Dime, Nickel Even, Quarters or Cover 6
